name: Rescue OOX-09/HL!
summary: Beyond Overlook Cliff, OOX-09/HL needs your help reaching the shore. Oglethorpe Obnoticus speaks through the fallen robot and asks you to escort it there. He waits in Booty Bay afterward.

sections.title: A Walk to the Shore
sections.body: Oglethorpe's voice crackles from the robot again. OOX-09/HL needs an open, safe place for its lengthy take-off procedure, and the shoreline beyond Overlook Cliff will do. Its built-in cloaking cannot yet be used. Oglethorpe needs time to make it work again.

sections.title: Word in Booty Bay
sections.body: When OOX-09/HL reaches the shore safely, Oglethorpe Obnoticus asks you to speak with him in Booty Bay.

faq.q: Where does the robot need to be escorted?
faq.answer: Take OOX-09/HL to the shoreline beyond Overlook Cliff. There, it has room to begin its take-off.

faq.q: Who is responsible for creating this homing robot?
faq.answer: The gnome Oglethorpe Obnoticus created the robot. He is in Booty Bay.

faq.q: Why can't the robot simply take off where it was found?
faq.answer: The lengthy take-off needs an open, safe place. Oglethorpe also needs time to make the robot's cloaking work again.

faq.q: Where do you go once the escort reaches the shore?
aliases: where to turn in rescue oox-09
faq.answer: Once OOX-09/HL is safely at the shore, Oglethorpe Obnoticus asks you to meet him in Booty Bay.
This follows Find OOX-09/HL!, when you carried the distress beacon to the crashed robot.
